clips.title: The story
paras: Ashlan Stonesmirk is a dwarven explosives expert assigned to the regiment guarding Dun Modr and the Thandol Span in the northern Wetlands. From there, he keeps a vigilant eye on regional dangers threatening the realm of Ironforge.

Positioned at Dun Modr in the northern Wetlands, Ashlan Stonesmirk serves the regiment guarding the Thandol Span. His expertise with explosives makes him a useful contact when suspicious materials threaten dwarven defenses.
